files.file_role_evidence: `StableFileError`, lexical path and no-follow directory helpers, `consume_regular_file`, atomic byte/JSON write, file replacement, multi-file and directory publication, rollback, recovery snapshots, descriptor-relative tree removal. Used by nearly all evidence validators/compiler/publishers. It is a security-sensitive shared primitive; concurrent-change handling and cleanup semantics are intricate. Requires POSIX-like `O_NOFOLLOW`, `O_DIRECTORY`, and Linux `renameat2` for safe publication operations. Static inspection only; no filesystem mutation helper called.
